$comment: See README.md in this directory. Add human recordings of the exact strings the tutor speaks most often. Files are matched after lowercasing, diacritic stripping and punctuation removal, so a recording only has to match the reply exactly.

recording.notes: Record in a quiet room with a close microphone. One file per line of `text`.

phrases.text: Sannu! Ku ne mai koyar da harshen Hausa. Ka fa za ka iya magana da ni?
